017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.bus.websocket;
018
019import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.bus.*;
020import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.filter.*;
021
022import jakarta.servlet.*;
023import jakarta.websocket.*;
024import jakarta.websocket.server.*;
025
026/**
027 * Registers the bus's WebSocket endpoint on the servlet container (Jakarta WebSocket 2.2).
028 *
029 * <p>
030 * The endpoint is context-relative ({@value #PATH}) because WebSocket endpoints are not servlet-mapped.  Origin is
031 * the CSRF control for the handshake, so registration refuses a policy with no Origin rule.  The rule is
032 * {@code LoopbackBoundary.origin()} for a {@code LoopbackBoundary}, the handshake's own scheme and Host for a
033 * {@code CsrfBoundary}, and {@code BusPolicy.allowedOrigins} when the policy has no boundary.  Any other boundary
034 * type is refused: the handshake cannot apply a boundary it does not know.
035 *
036 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
037 * <p class='bjava'>
038 *   <jc>// In a ServletContextListener (or the microservice's start hook):</jc>
039 *   <jk>public void</jk> contextInitialized(ServletContextEvent <jv>e</jv>) {
040 *     BusWebSockets.<jsm>register</jsm>(<jv>e</jv>.getServletContext(), JobsRest.<jsf>BUS</jsf>);   <jc>// "/juneau-bus/ws/{sessionId}"</jc>
041 *   }
042 *
043 *   <jc>// Jetty 12 (ee11), when you hold the ServletContextHandler:</jc>
044 *   JakartaWebSocketServletContainerInitializer.<jsm>configure</jsm>(<jv>context</jv>,
045 *     (<jv>servletContext</jv>, <jv>container</jv>) -&gt; BusWebSockets.<jsm>register</jsm>(<jv>container</jv>, JobsRest.<jsf>BUS</jsf>));
046 * </p>
047 *
048 * @since 10.0.0
049 */
050public final class BusWebSockets {
051
052   /** The context-relative endpoint path. */
053   @SuppressWarnings({
054      "java:S1075" // Documented default endpoint path; public constant
055   })
056   public static final String PATH = "/juneau-bus/ws/{sessionId}";
057
058   /** {@link #PATH} without its path parameter; passed to {@link ServerBus#enableWebSocket(String)}. */
059   @SuppressWarnings({
060      "java:S1075" // Documented default endpoint path; public constant
061   })
062   public static final String PREFIX = "/juneau-bus/ws";
063
064   static final String NO_CONTAINER = "BusWebSockets.register: the container exposes no jakarta.websocket ServerContainer (add the container's WebSocket module)";
065   static final String NO_ORIGIN = "BusWebSockets.register: the policy has neither a boundary nor allowedOrigins; WebSocket bridges need an exact Origin rule";
066
067   static final String UNSUPPORTED_BOUNDARY = "BusWebSockets.register: the policy's boundary type cannot be applied to a WebSocket handshake; use LoopbackBoundary or CsrfBoundary";
068
069   private BusWebSockets() {}
070
071   /**
072    * Registers the endpoint on the container found in the servlet context.
073    *
074    * @param ctx The servlet context.
075    * @param bus The bus whose sessions the endpoint serves.
076    * @throws IllegalStateException no {@link ServerContainer} attribute, no Origin rule, or a boundary type the
077    *    handshake cannot apply.
078    */
079   public static void register(ServletContext ctx, ServerBus bus) {
080      if (! (ctx.getAttribute(ServerContainer.class.getName()) instanceof ServerContainer container))
081         throw new IllegalStateException(NO_CONTAINER);
082      register(container, bus);
083   }
084
085   /**
086    * Registers the endpoint on a container.
087    *
088    * <p>
089    * Enables the bus's WebSocket transport only after the container accepted the endpoint, so a session POST never
090    * advertises a path that is not served.
091    *
092    * @param container The container.
093    * @param bus The bus whose sessions the endpoint serves.
094    * @throws IllegalStateException no Origin rule, a boundary type the handshake cannot apply, or the container
095    *    refused the endpoint.
096    */
097   public static void register(ServerContainer container, ServerBus bus) {
098      var boundary = bus.policy().boundary();
099      if (boundary != null && ! (boundary instanceof LoopbackBoundary) && ! (boundary instanceof CsrfBoundary))
100         throw new IllegalStateException(UNSUPPORTED_BOUNDARY);
101      var origins = BusWebSocketConfigurator.allowedOrigins(bus.policy());
102      if (origins.isEmpty() && ! (boundary instanceof CsrfBoundary))
103         throw new IllegalStateException(NO_ORIGIN);
104      var config = ServerEndpointConfig.Builder.create(BusWebSocketEndpoint.class, PATH)
105         .configurator(new BusWebSocketConfigurator(bus, origins))
106         .build();
107      try {
108         container.addEndpoint(config);
109      } catch (DeploymentException e) {
110         throw new IllegalStateException(String.format("BusWebSockets.register: could not add endpoint '%s': %s", PATH, e.getMessage()), e);
111      }
112      bus.enableWebSocket(PREFIX);
113   }
114}
